items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 135:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the rule of Malchut? The matter of the rule of Malchut is understood mainly as the completion of her vessels to ten [Sefirot], which are the main correction of the BAN, which is Malchut. For after she has ten vessels, behold, all the influx already reaches her from ZA, her husband, through the coupling of the day. However, the completion of the vessels of Rachel comes only at night, when the HGT of ZA rise and become KHB, and the NHY become HGT, and she acquires new NHY, which are clarified by Rachel at night in Beriah. And this rule of Rachel in Beriah is only at night, for by day she returns to Atzilut. (Item 5).
